title: Not to miss!
text: A great evening with a wonderful host/cook.  Claudia was great and got everyone laughing and cooking.  Felt like a gathering of friends at a  dinner party even though we were strangers.  Food was wonderful and tour of market interesting.  Don't miss this one.

title: Must do

title: Catalan cooking as a team
text: Very beautiful culinary experience with explanations and participation in the preparation of the dishes: tortilla, paella, and Catalan cream
author: Odette_A

title: A wonderful dinner in Barcelona !
text: This was a great experience. Friendly informative Chef Horia first led us on a tour of the market. Then back to the amazing beautiful apartment overlooking Plaça Reial. We were dinning with our two friends. Horia, provided history and culinary information about the dishes we prepared together. We all helped cook the food. Everything was delicious.
author: jameskloepper

title: A fantastic culinary experience at Just Royal!
text:
What a fantastic experience at Just Royal in Barcelona! Everything was perfect: from the beautiful location and warm welcome to the delicious recipes, clear explanations, and surprising flavor combinations.

The cooking workshop itself was incredibly fun and educational. Our cook was great: expert, enthusiastic, and friendly. The visit to the market with her was also an absolute plus. You not only get a glimpse into the local cuisine, but you also experience Barcelona in a different way.

Everything was meticulously taken care of and of course the dishes were delicious!

An absolute recommenda
author: Cosmopolitan527890

title: Great experience
text: So much more than we expected. Claudia was informative and real funny. All of us were laughing from the start. Everyone in the tour hit it off right away which made it easy. Like cooking with friends. The recipes were put over so good by Claudia that we all felt like chefs after.  All in all highly recommended
author: nicholasrB223SM

title: Basic men, ugly lights
text: What a brilliant afternoon!  Claudia, our leader was funny, engaging and bought out the best in our group.  We learnt a lot, we cooked a lot, we ate a lot and we laughed A LOT!!  Definitely, recommend this cooking experience.
author: Trek825157

title: If in doubt — cook it out!
text: OK, this is the very first cookie class I’ve ever taken. And it was by far the most fun, cultural, intimate, and all around superb way to get to know not only the region you’re in but the cultures of all those participating. It was a blast. It felt like Thanksgiving with new friends. Our guide and chef was incredible. Our group was so fun and I actually learned a lot about cooking. If you’re debating it just do it. I’ve always debated it and always thought man maybe not doesn’t sound like that much fun. Well I was wrong. It was a blast and I will be doing one on every vacation if possible. Fun
author: rynoinps
